title: Iseluleko Esiqoshwe Ngokuhlakanipha
intro: Cabanga umi eceleni komuntu owaziwayo hhayi ngezimangaliso noma imibuso, kodwa ngamazwi asaqondisa izinhliziyo nanamuhla. Le nceku ka-Allah yathola isipho esiyigugu futhi yathululela ukubonga kuzo zonke izeluleko ezinikezwa umfundi osemncane othandekayo.
clues: Ngabusiswa ngu-Allah ngokuhlakanipha, futhi ngayalwa ukuba ngibonge ngakho.
Ngikhulume nendodana yami ngeseluleko esinomusa, ngixwayisa ngothando nangokukhathalela.
Ngitshele indodana yami ukuthi ukuhlanganisa abalingani no-Allah kuyiphutha elikhulu.
Ngeluleka indodana yami ukuba ithandaze, iyale okulungile, yenqabe okubi, futhi ibekezele ngesineke.
Ngaxwayisa indodana yami ukuthi ingaphenduki isihlathi ngokuziqhenya noma ihambe emhlabeni ngokuzikhukhumeza.
Ngifundise indodana yami ukuba ibe nesivinini esilinganiselayo futhi yehlise izwi, ngoba umsindo onzima kakhulu ukukhala kwezimbongolo.

trial.label: Iseluleko Sami Esikhulu Kunazo Zonke

Ukwakha umkhumbi ukuze usinde kuzamcolo omkhulu
trial.answer: Ukweluleka ingane yami ukuba ingahlanganisi no-Allah

outcome.label: Indlela Engikhunjulwa Ngayo

Njengomuntu obhujiswe ukuqhuma okukhulu okuvela esibhakabhakeni
outcome.answer: Njengesibonelo sokubonga kanye neseluleko sabazali esihlakaniphile

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
